description: Prefer this to deleting one entity and re-adding its observations and relations to another: merge an entity into another, unioning their observations and repointing its relations. The target keeps its name; the absorbed entity is deleted. It cannot be undone, so pass dryRun first to see the observations joined, the relations repointed and the name that disappears; find_duplicates proposes pairs that look like the same thing.

dryRun.description: Report what the merges would change, and write nothing; omit for a real merge

merges.description: One entry per merge: the entity to absorb and delete, and the entity it merges into

from.description: The name of the entity to merge in and delete

into.description: The name of the entity it is merged into

name: merge_entities
title: Merge Entities
